verdict.rationale: Dropbox's official Files API documents reading files and folders (dropbox-docs-3), and the official SDK shows listing folder contents (dropbox-gh-1). Team namespaces can also be listed (dropbox-docs-7). Together these offer a first-party way to retrieve stored files in the formats they were uploaded in, but nothing documents a dedicated bulk export or account-exit feature. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-account export, export of metadata (sharing, versions, comments) in open formats, an account-departure/offboarding flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
